trailhead: Trinity Trailhead (end of Chiwawa River Road)
oldDirection: From the Trinity Trailhead (~2,800 ft) at the end of Chiwawa Valley Road 6200
proposedDirection: From US-2 at Coles Corner, turn north on SR 207 and go about 4.4 miles, turn right onto Chiwawa Loop Road, then take the second left onto Chiwawa River Road (Forest Road 6200). Follow it about 23 miles to the Trinity Trailhead; it turns to gravel at about 11 miles and the last stretch is very rough.
problem: The road is the Chiwawa River Road (Forest Road 6200), not "Chiwawa Valley Road", and the text gives no drive.

oldDirection: Start at the Tupso Pass trailhead (end of FR 41) on the Three Fingers-Goat Flats-Saddle Lake Trail #641.

problem: The text implies a drive to the end of FR 41, but the road is washed out and permanently closed to vehicles well short of the trailhead.
